title: 공군미사일방어사령부령 / queue:ADDENDUM:24580:20130611:00001:part:1/1
full_text:
Addendum <Presidential Decree No. 24580, June 11, 2013>
Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
This Decree shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.
Article 2 (Amendment of Other Statutes and Regulations)
Part of the Enforcement Decree of the Military Personnel Management Act shall be amended as follows:
In Article 13 (1) 1 (c), "Commander of the Air Force Air Defense Artillery Command" shall be replaced with "Commander of the Air Force Air Defense Guided Missile Command,".
In Article 14 (1) 3 (a) and (b), "air defense artillery units" shall in each case be replaced with "air defense guided missile units".
In the column for Air Force positions in attached Table 1, "Commander of the Air Force Air Defense Artillery Command" shall be replaced with "Commander of the Air Force Air Defense Guided Missile Command".
